pillars.label: Customer health
pillars.meaning: Share of baseline order value held by accounts with no elevated-or-worse risk.
pillars.implication: A drop means more of the business sits with customers showing a multi-signal risk pattern.

pillars.label: Supply continuity
pillars.meaning: Portfolio fill rate over the last 4 weeks: units shipped / units ordered.
pillars.implication: Below the high-90s usually means a supply-side problem we caused, not demand.

pillars.label: Service quality
pillars.meaning: Share of support tickets answered within the 8-hour SLA in the last 4 weeks.
pillars.implication: Falling SLA compliance makes supply problems feel like neglect to customers.

pillars.label: Field coverage
pillars.meaning: Touchpoints in the last 4 weeks vs the portfolio's normal 4-week level (capped at 100).
pillars.implication: Relationships fade quietly before orders fall.

pillars.label: Commercial momentum
pillars.meaning: 50 + percentage change in seasonality-adjusted units vs the normal 4-week level.
pillars.implication: Above 50 means growing after seasonality; below 50 means shrinking.
